scope: All 56 Leads: complete identity/metadata and 11,424 exact parameter values; not full fresh audio coverage.
mono_priority: Not implemented. Mode 0=8 voices, 1=16 voices, 2/3/4=unison x2/x4/x8; no mono claim.

programs.name: Ribbon Lead
programs.description: A smooth, centered lead for ribbon gestures. Short portamento and a small upward onset scoop connect phrases; a restrained upper edge keeps large slides readable. A gently open body, a defined attack and a clean key release.

programs.name: Metal Lead
programs.description: A clean center tone mixed with 280 Hz ring sidebands for a metallic edge. The restrained wet blend preserves pitch identity while pressure brightens the source. A forward attack color with a compact main decay and a separately controlled accent.

programs.name: Amber Leads 115
programs.description: A compact circuit brass body is supported by a harmonic lip spectrum, then a brighter saw edge. The short accent settles into a centered sustain; velocity controls breath effort and pressure adds bloom. Separate short releases keep single lines clear. A warm main body with a slightly longer decay; the separate attack stays concise.
programs.character_scope: electronic lead with acoustic-inspired body color

programs.name: Velvet Leads 116
programs.description: A rounded saw-and-sine body with a quiet soft pulse edge. Gently staggered attacks and restrained pressure brightness keep slow phrases warm and centered. A covered upper register and rounded main release, preserving the shorter edge.

programs.name: Distant Leads 117
programs.description: A dark saw body blooms into a later brass edge. Pressure opens the sustained tone and adds controlled vibrato; moderate chorus and a long release support spacious single lines. A subdued upper edge over a longer body ending; characteristic body detail remains present.

programs.name: Neon Leads 118
programs.description: A focused, aggressive upper resonance responds strongly to pressure. A quieter saw-and-sine body holds the pitch beneath the brighter edge; vibrato stays controlled. A forward attack color with a compact main decay and a separately controlled accent.

programs.name: Hollow Leads 119
programs.description: A near-square body and a quieter moving pulse create a hollow tone with slow harmonic motion. The lower-width body stays stable while the second rank carries most of the PWM. A lightly focused filter band over a longer body, with restrained resonance on acoustic models.

programs.name: Golden Leads 120
programs.description: A firm saw body with a lighter pulse edge. Velocity shapes the onset; pressure adds level, brilliance and gentle vibrato. The wheel supplies additional controlled vibrato. A gently open body, a defined attack and a clean key release.

programs.name: Frozen Leads 121
programs.description: A single 4' sine with a small upward scoop and quick breath-like articulation. Pressure adds restrained vibrato and level; no lower-octave rank is mixed in. The pure sine has a slower, steady entrance and a long pressure-shaped ending.

programs.name: Electric Leads 122
programs.description: A moving resonant edge above a warmer body. Pressure raises the filter focus while modest low-cut settings retain a pitched foundation. A quick, forward edge that settles into a more compact body.

programs.name: Midnight Leads 123
programs.description: One 8' sine with a soft onset, long glide and expressive pressure level. Gentle pressure vibrato gives a theremin-like gesture without an unintended beating second oscillator. The pure sine enters softly and lingers at a slightly recessed held level.

programs.name: Slow Leads 124
programs.description: A steady saw-and-pulse tone with long, smooth portamento between notes. Gentle envelope motion keeps the glide audible without adding an onset pitch scoop. A slower main entrance and longer ending, preserving the source's brief accents.

programs.name: Bright Leads 125
programs.description: A narrow pulse body with a lighter, differently voiced pulse edge. The dry, nasal tone has a clear attack and restrained vibrato for agile lines. A more open upper contour with a clear accent and slightly tighter main decay.

programs.name: Dark Leads 126
programs.description: A focused clarinet-like harmonic body meets a quieter double-reed and pulse edge. A definite tongue onset and short breath release keep lines dry and articulate; pressure adds nasal intensity and restrained vibrato without removing the fundamental. A covered upper contour with a tidy ending, retaining the instrument body's defining modes.
programs.character_scope: electronic lead with acoustic-inspired body color

programs.name: Wide Leads 127
programs.description: Two sustained saw ranks with a deliberate 12-cent offset. Their different filters and attacks create a broad beating lead without added chorus or deep pressure vibrato. Complementary ranks spread across stereo with a restrained, register-appropriate width and a centered composite image.

programs.name: Soft Leads 128
programs.description: One pure 8' sine with a rounded onset. Pressure controls level and a gentle vibrato; filter brilliance is intentionally inactive on this bypass-sine voice. The pure sine has a cushioned entrance, expressive dynamics and a rounded ending.

programs.name: Amber Leads 129
programs.description: A dark harmonic brass body supports a slower saw-and-pulse bloom and a sustained release. Pressure brings out the brighter crown while moderate detune supplies width. A warm main body with a slightly longer decay; the separate attack stays concise.

programs.name: Velvet Leads 130
programs.description: A centered, singing lead whose vibrato grows with pressure to roughly a quarter-tone peak-to-peak. The quiet dry tone is stable; pressure supplies most of the expressive level and vibrato, while velocity gives a smaller onset contrast. A covered upper register and rounded main release, preserving the shorter edge.

programs.name: Distant Leads 131
programs.description: A smooth, centered lead for ribbon gestures. Short portamento and a small upward onset scoop connect phrases; a restrained upper edge keeps large slides readable. A subdued upper edge over a longer body ending; characteristic body detail remains present.

programs.name: Neon Leads 132
programs.description: Strike velocity controls a wide range of level and brightness. The quiet static gain lets soft notes stay soft, while hard strikes reveal a more prominent pulse edge. A forward attack color with a compact main decay and a separately controlled accent.

programs.name: Hollow Leads 133
programs.description: A hollow 8' square body with a quieter same-register square edge. Nearly unison tuning and dry, quick articulation preserve the centered odd-harmonic character. A lightly focused filter band over a longer body, with restrained resonance on acoustic models.

programs.name: Golden Leads 134
programs.description: A solid 8' saw under a sustained 4' pulse crown. The octave has a higher cutoff and a lighter level, so its presence stays clear without taking over the lead. A gently open body, a defined attack and a clean key release.

programs.name: Frozen Leads 135

programs.name: Trill Lead

programs.name: Glissando Lead
